fields.title: New Participants Page Design
fields.content:
We’ve updated our participants section in the SaaSquatch portal to provide improved data accessibility and a better user experience. A new key feature that you’ll notice is the option to **DELETE a user**. This is part of our recent changes to ensure that the SaaSquatch platform remains GDPR compliant. You can can read more about our GDPR updates [here](/features/participant-deletion). Updated portal pages include: * All Users list * Participants list * User Profile Page #### User Profile Updates ![Participant profile improvements](//images.ctfassets.net/s68ib1kj8k5n/XtNuoy2w6WeWSussmqmE6/cbde512dbfe9eca0555479c33b1b45fe/Participant_profile_improvements.png) Changes you’ll notice on the User Profile Page include:
  1. A new 'User Summary' screen with improved user management functionality and most importantly, the option to DELETE a User. Click here to learn more.
  2. An improved and more data-rich 'User Details' display
  3. Quickview of users current active Segments
  4. Updated Rewards list that provides:
    1. High level summary of each users rewards, for quicker analysis
    2. Individual rewards management
    3. Additional reward details for a more complete review
  5. Updated Referral details and activity views
Preview
#### Participant Lists Changes to the **All Users** and **Referral Participant** lists include: 1. Updated styling 2. Refined User ID display 3. Updated search functionality
